checks: exact registered initial URL and source ID
matchingAndIntegrity.redirects: Only this registered Archive source follows redirects. Final HTTPS archive.org or subdomain must retain the exact registered item/file path (download or numbered CDN items form), no query/fragment/credentials/port. ALEA keeps redirect:error.
matchingAndIntegrity.playback: Create a RAM-only Blob from the exact SHA-checked complete bytes; no second unchecked media request.
matchingAndIntegrity.acousticCoverage: Three separated windows of an approximately 30-second official catalog preview correlate about 0.99. This does not independently compare the rest of the complete master.

liveGate.scope: Production source modules loaded for a bounded module-level browser gate, with actual catalog/provider networking and native HTMLAudio. Does not claim a second complete compiled product UI flow.
